notes.title: Demo v0.2.0
notes.content: [p]We have updated the demo to keep it closer to what the final game is shaping up to be. This update features a visual overhaul, UI updates, various gameplay changes and fixes. Don't worry, we will share more details about new content, think this as a little teaser![/p][p][/p][p][b]Seasons:[/b] Environment changes as the time progresses through the game, making it easier to judge the current date. We replaced all foliage assets with more stylized and dynamic versions that reacts to seasons and weather.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Warehouse:[/b] Incoming crates are now visible separately and stack in front of the delivery station. Sold items now don't disappear, for each customer a cargo box is filled in with appropriate products by workers.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bank:[/b] You can now borrow loans from the bank.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Contracts:[/b] There is a new way to make a quick cash: contracts! Once a contract is accepted you have limited time time to reach sales target. There is a penalty to pay if you fail, so it is a risky business.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Refund:[/b] Some customers try to trick you with weird reasons or expired refund requests. You have to be careful and decide accordingly if a request is valid.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Save/Load:[/b] You can now save your progress and keep playing from where you left off! Please note that your save files won't be compatible with full release.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your continued support and feedback! If you run into any issue or have some suggestions for us, please feel free to reach us.[/p]

notes.title: E-Shop Tycoon Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]We are excited to announce that the demo of E-Shop Tycoon is now available! 
[/h1]

Now, after a year's of hard work, a demo version with a short gameplay is available for our valued players to try.

In this demo version, you can experience most of the basic mechanics, although it's just the beginning. For now, the demo only includes the garage stage and the first objectives. There is an estimated 30-40 minutes of gameplay.

Keep in mind that the demo version may have bugs and will not provide a full game experience. You can report these bugs and feedback to us via our [url=https://discord.gg/zbUnvxCFpd]Discord[/url] server.
